## Où j'en suis
The HubSpot work moved from webhooks to polling: `client.search_companies` and `sync_companies` poll the CRM every 15 minutes, page past the 10k search cap using time windows, and only fetch companies with ARR > 0 (commits 8b3e6f1, 2d90ac4, ae47c15). PR #409 is open with auto-merge enabled, but the required e2e check `test_admin_accounts.py::test_accounts_table_shows_owner` fails (3 owner rows expected, 2 found), so nothing is merged yet.

- [en-cours] the e2e fixture still contains a trial company with an owner, which the new ARR > 0 filter skips
- [prochaine-étape] update that fixture (ARR > 0 on the third company, or expect 2 rows), then let auto-merge squash #409
- [essai-raté] registering webhook subscriptions by API returned 401: private app tokens can't manage them
- [décision] poll instead of webhooks, close #405 (source: t04)
- [décision] sync only companies with ARR > 0, trials skipped (source: t10)
- [décision] HUBSPOT_TOKEN to Secrets Manager via Noa, PR opened with auto-merge (source: t12)
